Bring your game

Install Gunslugs3.zip, then copy your owned gunslugs3.dat into the installed gunslugs3 folder. See gunslugs3.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.

Install the port

  1. Update PortMaster. Copy Gunslugs3.zip into its autoinstall/ folder and open PortMaster.
  2. Allow PortMaster to download Java 17 and Westonpack. An internet connection is needed if these runtimes are not installed.
  3. Copy the owned game files into gunslugs3/ as described above. Launch Gunslugs 3 Rogue Tactics from your ports menu.
Manual installation paths

1. Update PortMaster. Put Gunslugs3.zip in PortMaster's autoinstall/ directory, then open PortMaster to install it. Connect to the network to download Java 17 and Westonpack if they are not installed yet. 2. Copy the owned file to <ports directory>/gunslugs3/gunslugs3.dat. 3. Launch Gunslugs 3 Rogue Tactics from your firmware's ports menu.

For manual installation on muOS, extract the ZIP on your computer and copy Gunslugs 3 Rogue Tactics.sh to <SD card>/roms/PORTS/, and the gunslugs3/ folder to <SD card>/ports/ on the card configured as the firmware's ports location. The required file is <SD card>/ports/gunslugs3/gunslugs3.dat.

For ArkOS/dArkOS and standard ports layouts, extract the ZIP into your configured ports directory (for example /roms/ports/ or /roms2/ports/) so Gunslugs 3 Rogue Tactics.sh and gunslugs3/ are beside each other. Use the firmware's configured ports location; the launcher uses PortMaster's directory value. Avoid creating an extra Gunslugs3/ wrapper folder.

Saves & troubleshooting

Back up gunslugs3/saves/ before updates. Read gunslugs3/log.txt if startup fails. Report your device, exact firmware version, resolution and steps to reproduce, and attach the log. Test menu navigation, gameplay, audio, game speed, save/reload, suspend/resume and clean exit. Keep purchased game files private.
